definitions.explanation: The ninth month of the year. The new school term resumes after summer vacation. Features the autumn equinox.

examples.japanese: {九月|くがつ}は{涼|すず}しくなります。
{九月|くがつ}から{学校|がっこう}が{始|はじ}まります。
{九月|くがつ}の{終|お}わりに{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip at the end of September.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{九月|くがつ}になると{秋|あき}を{感|かん}じるようになって、{夏|なつ}の{暑|あつ}さも{少|すこ}しずつ{終|お}わります。
examples.english: In Japan, once September comes, you start to feel autumn, and the summer heat gradually ends.

notes: September uses く (9), not きゅう. The second semester begins in September in Japan. The autumn equinox (秋分の日) falls around September 23rd and is a national holiday.
